items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: No, I played with them too... Jack Fajida. He used to play with the old man, Johnny... Jack Fajida. He was playing a little bit of a little bit of a... Cornet.

ctx.x: His brother, no. No, I played with them too. He had a little fellow playing with him. Joe, what did they have? Joe, we called him Joe. A little bit of a little fellow playing cornet with him. So I went round there and... Jack Fajida. He used to play with the old man, Johnny. Johnny was playing bass. Herbert was playing violin. The old man was playing guitar. Jack Fajida. Jack Fajida. Jack Fajida. He was playing a little bit of a little bit of a... Cornet. Cornet. Yeah, he didn't have no crannets. Let's see. Who…
Oh yeah. Who was playing violin. Oh yeah, so that was a lead. Yeah, it was a lead.
